mentions.name: buzz
mentions.description: Self-hosted WebDAV server tightly integrated with Real-Debrid, Jellyfin, and OpenSubtitles. It exposes debrid media so that folders present a single file where the original source has many, adds confirmation for removing Debrid entries, keeps an archive so deletions can be restored, offers a simple but powerful OpenSubtitles integration for subtitles, and includes a functional logs UI. It also serves the author as a way to review web design concepts and experiment with coding agents, both local and SOTA.
mentions.problem: Jellyfin requires a single file per folder even when the original source contains many files; the app solves this, and also lacks-safety around Debris deletions are addressed with removal confirmations and a restorable archive.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been using https://github.com/gchamon/buzz as an opportunity to have a WebDAV with tight integration with real  debrid, jellyfin and opensubtitles.
